# Content strategy

## Summary
Pages that solve one task each, with real how-to text [E: inference; medium; S-006; 2026-11-18].

## Topic clusters
- resize to size: 20 KB, 50 KB presets on one page.
- compress pdf.

## Landing-page roadmap
GRO-002 first.

## Internal linking plan
Each tool links to two related tools and one guide.

## Content quality rules
No near-duplicate pages per size; every page has unique instructions [E: fact; high; S-006; 2026-11-18].
